I would like to give you some feedback on my experience, but I would like to do this in a respectful, fair-minded way. I hope you take it in the spirit in which it is offered.

I am a long-standing blood donor. I was unable to donate at my last appointment. because of a low Iron level. Their protocol determined I should have a follow up blood test at my GP. I attempted to book this at the practice but was told it would need to be authorised by the GP, this is understandable. I attempted to do this through PATCHS. The first two days this was not possible as there was no capacity in the system. This was the same on the third day, but then at 12.00 midday I managed to access then system. Not sure when it clears? I assumed the beginning of the day? PATCHS was then excellent, and a blood test authorised within the hour. But attempting to make the appointment was more problematic. 3 days, about 10 attempts, different times of day, on the phone for a total of around 3 hours could not get through. Some of these the automated service said I was first in the que. Based on how long I was waiting I have some doubts about this. In the end I walked to the surgery and made the appointment face to face. There were two receptionists, not unpleasant, but quite “minimalist” in their interactions, empty waiting room, they were not do anything that would have prevented them from answering a phone. Not sure if these are people responsible for incoming calls? Appointment was made, the earliest available was 18 working days. I guess I am lucky it was routine.

Having worked in public service, including healthcare for 50 years I do appreciate there are often hidden complexities that the public may not see. But overall impression. Some parts of the system seem to work and some not. Could the donation centre have taken my blood? PATCHS works well when you can access it. Incredibly hard to get through to the GP. Long appointment wait for something that feels very routine and quick to do. When I am seen, based on previous experience I every confidence that it will be efficient and the staff respectful. But it feels it is harder than it should be and with some concentrated thought some opportunities for quick wins here.",null,[0,95]]]],[null,1754484280000000,1754484280000000,"7 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/4384747312189980518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhV0dNd2FGaGtXRloyVWxWb1lWRlVTbEJWTTA1V1l6SkdORkp1WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/4384747312189980518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhV0dNd2FGaGtXRloyVWxWb1lWRlVTbEJWTTA1V1l6SkdORkp1WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/4384747312189980518/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhV0dNd2FGaGtXRloyVWxWb1lWRlVTbEJWTTA1V1l6SkdORkp1WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/4384747312189980518/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhV0dNd2FGaGtXRloyVWxWb1lWRlVTbEJWTTA1V1l6SkdORkp1WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/4384747312189980518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhV0dNd2FGaGtXRloyVWxWb1lWRlVTbEJWTTA1V1l6SkdORkp1WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/4384747312189980518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhV0dNd2FGaGtXRloyVWxWb1lWRlVTbEJWTTA1V1l6SkdORkp1WXhBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for your feedback.
